# Image metadata remover

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/metadata-remover/

Re-encode a browser-readable image to remove its original embedded metadata. Save a new copy while keeping the original file unchanged.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Create a fresh JPEG copy before sharing a camera image that may contain EXIF information.

## Limits and checks

Canvas export removes original metadata and can change image quality or color handling. It does not remove details visible in the picture.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
